title: Senegal national grid emission factor
description: CO2e per MWh from Senegal's grid. No figure is published by SENELEC or the regulator (CRSE); the best national figure found is the ex-post operating margin computed with the UNFCCC CDM grid tool from Senegal's national energy balance for GIZ's Programme Energies Durables. The OM excludes low-cost / must-run plants (OMVS hydro imports, solar, ~15% in 2018), so it sits above the generation average; that roughly offsets the T&D losses (~17%) when applied at low voltage. ecoinvent 3.11's SN low-voltage market characterises to ~0.31 kgCO2e/kWh in this store (ReCiPe 2016 H), understating it ~2.4x.

regional_reference.what: UNFCCC ASB0034 WAPP standardized baseline (update ASU_006, Feb 2021), combined margin, all projects except wind/solar, 1st crediting period; OM 0.578, BM 0.556; data vintage 2019. WAPP-wide (9 countries), so not national.
